items.title: A Tutorial on Diffusion Theory: From Differential Equations to Diffusion Models
items.summary: Diffusion models have emerged as a dominant framework for generative modeling, but their mathematical foundations are often presented separately through diffusion probabilistic models, score-based modeling, stochastic differential equations, and numerical sampling methods. We write this tutorial to provide a unified and self-contained account of these viewpoints from the perspective of differential equations. Starting from a conditional Gaussian noising process, we derive ordinary differential equation (ODE) and stochastic differential equation (SDE) representations, pass to the corresponding marginal forward dynamics, and then obtain the reverse-time SDE and probability-flow ODE that make generation possible. We show that the central unknown quantity in reverse sampling is the marginal score, explain how score matching becomes the standard denoising objective under a noise-prediction parameterization, and discuss practical reverse-time sampling and guidance. We further place DDPM, DDIM, flow matching, and score-based SDEs in a common framework, and conclude with diffusion language models in continuous embedding space together with a brief discussion of discrete masked-token diffusion. The tutorial is intended as a bridge between the analytical foundations of diffusion processes and the modern generative algorithms built upon them.

items.title: Generalized Contrastive Divergence: Joint Training of Energy-Based Model and Diffusion Model through Inverse Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: We present Generalized Contrastive Divergence (GCD), a novel objective function for training an energy-based model (EBM) and a sampler simultaneously. GCD generalizes Contrastive Divergence (Hinton, 2002), a celebrated algorithm for training EBM, by replacing Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) distribution with a trainable sampler, such as a diffusion model. In GCD, the joint training of EBM and a diffusion model is formulated as a minimax problem, which reaches an equilibrium when both models converge to the data distribution. The minimax learning with GCD bears interesting equivalence to inverse reinforcement learning, where the energy corresponds to a negative reward, the diffusion model is a policy, and the real data is expert demonstrations. We present preliminary yet promising results showing that joint training is beneficial for both EBM and a diffusion model. GCD enables EBM training without MCMC while improving the sample quality of a diffusion model.

items.title: Fixed Point Diffusion Models
items.summary: We introduce the Fixed Point Diffusion Model (FPDM), a novel approach to image generation that integrates the concept of fixed point solving into the framework of diffusion-based generative modeling. Our approach embeds an implicit fixed point solving layer into the denoising network of a diffusion model, transforming the diffusion process into a sequence of closely-related fixed point problems. Combined with a new stochastic training method, this approach significantly reduces model size, reduces memory usage, and accelerates training. Moreover, it enables the development of two new techniques to improve sampling efficiency: reallocating computation across timesteps and reusing fixed point solutions between timesteps. We conduct extensive experiments with state-of-the-art models on ImageNet, FFHQ, CelebA-HQ, and LSUN-Church, demonstrating substantial improvements in performance and efficiency. Compared to the state-of-the-art DiT model, FPDM contains 87% fewer parameters, consumes 60% less memory during training, and improves image generation quality in situations where sampling computation or time is limited. Our code and pretrained models are available at https://lukemelas.github.io/fixed-point-diffusion-models.

items.title: Video Diffusion Models: A Survey
items.summary: Diffusion generative models have recently become a powerful technique for creating and modifying high-quality, coherent video content. This survey provides a comprehensive overview of the critical components of diffusion models for video generation, including their applications, architectural design, and temporal dynamics modeling. The paper begins by discussing the core principles and mathematical formulations, then explores various architectural choices and methods for maintaining temporal consistency. A taxonomy of applications is presented, categorizing models based on input modalities such as text prompts, images, videos, and audio signals. Advancements in text-to-video generation are discussed to illustrate the state-of-the-art capabilities and limitations of current approaches. Additionally, the survey summarizes recent developments in training and evaluation practices, including the use of diverse video and image datasets and the adoption of various evaluation metrics to assess model performance. The survey concludes with an examination of ongoing challenges, such as generating longer videos and managing computational costs, and offers insights into potential future directions for the field. By consolidating the latest research and developments, this survey aims to serve as a valuable resource for researchers and practitioners working with video diffusion models. Website: https://github.com/ndrwmlnk/Awesome-Video-Diffusion-Models

items.title: LDM3D-VR: Latent Diffusion Model for 3D VR
items.summary: Latent diffusion models have proven to be state-of-the-art in the creation and manipulation of visual outputs. However, as far as we know, the generation of depth maps jointly with RGB is still limited. We introduce LDM3D-VR, a suite of diffusion models targeting virtual reality development that includes LDM3D-pano and LDM3D-SR. These models enable the generation of panoramic RGBD based on textual prompts and the upscaling of low-resolution inputs to high-resolution RGBD, respectively. Our models are fine-tuned from existing pretrained models on datasets containing panoramic/high-resolution RGB images, depth maps and captions. Both models are evaluated in comparison to existing related methods.

items.title: A simple explainer of the massive crypto heist at Binance : NPR
items.summary:
A unique feature of crypto exchanges is that people can buy and sell digital currencies such as bitcoin — and leave them with the exchanges for safekeeping.

This dual trust in the exchange makes them mighty tempting targets for hackers. And what's more concerning for critics, crypto exchanges also don't have to follow the same strict regulations that govern established Wall Street firm. [...] ### So first, what are crypto exchanges?

They are akin to the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) or the Nasdaq, but instead of trading stocks, investors turn to Binance and other crypto exchanges to trade digital assets such as Bitcoin.

A wide range of investors trade cryptocurrencies at these exchanges, from financial institutions and sophisticated traders, all the way to regular investors looking to make some money.

### OK, so what happened this week? [...] "So the regulatory framework for crypto is much weaker than what investors in the US enjoy in other markets," says Fischer.

Though Binance has promised to pay back customers who lost funds, it is not necessarily bound to do so according to current regulations. And many critics worry that smaller exchanges could struggle to pay back their investors in case of a hack, leaving these traders to suffer the consequences.

### Doesn't this reinforce the crypto sector's Wild West reputation?

items.title: Binance loses $6.3 billion in crypto heist—what happens to your money when an exchange gets hacked
items.summary:
With self-custody, you use your own crypto wallet and control the private keys used to authorize transactions on the blockchain. Wallets typically come with a recovery phrase — essentially a master password that can be used to restore access to the wallet if you lose it.

That gives you control of your crypto without relying on an exchange, but it also makes you responsible for keeping that information safe. [...] “When you leave crypto on an exchange, you are relying on that company’s controls and its balance sheet,” says Martin Mulyadi, YHB Endowed Chair in Accounting and professor of accounting at Shenandoah University. “A pledge to make customers whole is only as strong as the resources behind it.”

### What you should look for when choosing a crypto exchange [...] A record-breaking hack at Binance, the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange, is a reminder of the risks investors take when trusting a company to hold their digital tokens.

Binance said Friday that the security breach affectedabout $6.3 billion in client assets, making it the largest crypto hack on record. Around $3 billion of the affected assets has been frozen on blockchain networks, and the exchange says it has begun recovering some of them.

Nổi bật là nguy cơ gia tăng các cuộc tấn công mạng có tính tự động hóa cao, tinh vi và khó phát hiện. AI cho phép các đối tượng nhanh chóng phn tích hệ thống, xác định lỗ hổng bảo mật, tối ưu hóa phương thức xm nhập và điều chỉnh hành vi mã độc nhằm né tránh các cơ chế phòng vệ truyền thống. Bên cạnh đó, AI tạo sinh bị lợi dụng để tạo lập [...] Cùng với đó, phát triển AI theo hướng an toàn, minh bạch và có trách nhiệm đang trở thành định hướng quan trọng trong quản trị công nghệ. Trọng tm không chỉ dừng lại ở nng cao hiệu suất và khả năng ứng dụng AI mà còn chú trọng kiểm soát rủi ro, bảo đảm tính minh bạch, khả năng giải trình, bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhn và quyền lợi của người sử dụng. Nếu trước đy các nguy cơ chủ yếu xuất phát từ virus, mã độc hoặc các cuộc tấn công mạng truyền thống thì hiện nay, AI đã được khai thác để thực hiện nhiều hình thức tấn công tinh vi hơn. items.summary: Cùng với ứng dụng, Hưng Yên yêu cầu bảo đảm quản trị AI an toàn, đáng tin cậy. 100% hệ thống AI do cơ quan nhà nước triển khai phải được đánh giá về an toàn, dữ liệu, quyền riêng tư, độ chính xác và rủi ro trước khi vận hành chính thức. Việc kết nối, chia sẻ, khai thác dữ liệu phải tun thủ quy định về bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhn và bí mật nhà nước. [...] Đối với nhn lực, kế hoạch xác định chương trình đào tạo ba tầng, gồm phổ cập nhận thức cho toàn dn; kỹ năng ứng dụng theo vị trí việc làm cho cán bộ, công chức; đào tạo chuyên su cho lực lượng kỹ thuật, dữ liệu và lãnh đạo. Mục tiêu đến năm 2030 là 100% cán bộ, công chức, viên chức được phổ cập kỹ năng sử dụng AI an toàn, có trách nhiệm, đồng thời hình thành đội ngũ nòng cốt tại các sở, ngành và xã, phường. [...] AI được triển khai trong nhiều lĩnh vực: đất đai, quy hoạch, xy dựng thông qua GIS và ảnh viễn thám để phát hiện biến động; nông nghiệp để dự báo su bệnh, năng suất và tối ưu sản xuất; môi trường để phn tích quan trắc, cảnh báo ô nhiễm, ngập lụt. Trong y tế, giáo dục, lao động, giao thông, logistics, năng lượng và đô thị, AI hỗ trợ chuyên môn, dự báo nhu cầu và tối ưu công tác quản lý, vận hành.

items.summary:
CNBC　20:47 掲載

Anthropicは、ナスダック上場を目指すAI研究所として、今後のIPOで70ドルから78ドルの価格帯を設定しました。

Anthropic sets price range of $70 to $78 in upcoming IPO as AI lab marches towards Nasdaq

Anthropic's IPO is expected to come roughly five months after Elon Musk took SpaceX public in a record offering.

https://t.co/rO3OV2AyIi

提示された上限値では、アンソロピックはIPOを通じて最大643億5000万ドルの資金を調達することになる。同社の時価総額は、5月の資金調達ラウンドで発表した9650億ドルから、完全希薄化後ベースで最大1兆4050億ドルにまで上昇する可能性がある。

アンソロピック社の経営陣は投資家への売り込み準備を進める一方で、先週の中間選挙で民主党が議会を席巻し、AI開発のペースを鈍化させる可能性のある州レベルの住民投票が多数可決されたことを受け、激動の政治情勢に対処しなければならない。さらに、金利上昇によって高額なインフラ投資に必要な資金を調達する企業が債務を抱えきれなくなることを懸念し、AI関連銘柄への投資にますます懐疑的になっている株式市場にも直面している。

CNBCは先週、アンソロピックの投資家の一部が、以前の予想よりも低い企業価値評価に備えていると報じた。アントロピックは最近まで2兆ドルの評価額を目指していたが、株主はCNBCに対し、1.5兆ドルでさえも疑わしいと述べ、ある投資家はその数字を「無理がある」と評した。

アンソロピックが予定通り今月中にティッカーシンボル「ANT」でナスダックに上場すれば、スペースXの上場から約5ヶ月後となる。

同社は記録的な規模の株式公開を行い、857億ドルを調達した。イーロン・マスク氏が率いる再利用可能なロケットとAI企業である同社の時価総額は2兆ドル弱で、これはIPO当時の評価額とほぼ同水準である。

items.title: Happy Launch Week!
items.summary:
Happy Launch Week!

I know you've heard those words many times this month, but this time, there's actually something to be excited about

We've been expecting new frontier models from major AI labs since October, and after yesterday's Fable 5.2 release, things are finally swinging in our favour.

And this week could get even crazier.

- Gemini 4 Carbon: We woke up to exciting speculation after Logan's cryptic post, suggesting Gemini 4 Carbon could finally become widely available later today.

- Grok 4.8: Elon Musk has hinted at a release this week, with Grok Bot users reportedly getting early access before a wider rollout.

- Fable 5.5: Turns out yesterday's Fable 5.2 is a separate model, meaning Fable 5.5 is still expected. Personally, I think it'll outperform every other frontier model released this year. The separate subscription might be pricey, but Opus 5.5 is already in a league of its own.

- GPT-6.2 Astra: OpenAI has been unusually quiet since GPT-6.1, and we're still waiting to see what Astra brings.

The Big Week is here
